notes: Hybrid Carpet Tag. Combines the proven visual hierarchy of the office Word carpet tags with RUNLU QR intelligence and the existing double-sided cutting-history back. Front labels now emphasize Roll # first, Product/Collection second, Colour third, then enlarged LOT, SIZE and MFG ROLL fields while preserving QR Scan to View & Edit. Browser preview/print and Word export use the same hierarchy. Back-side Original Size, DATE/PO/NAME/SALES/CUT/BAL cutting table, reversed duplex alignment and QR remain intact. No inventory, cloud-sync, Cut Piece Return or database schema changes.
